Nora (CS): FYI Meridian onboarding health check — p50 220ms, p95 930ms, avg token cost ~1.9x our baseline. Customer says answers are fine but UX lagging. Renewal flagged (60d). Looking for quick perf levers: quantization, model swap, routing. Any low-risk proposals?
Arjun (ML Eng): short answer: yes. Start with q4-style quant (int4/q4_0) on a canary. Usually minimal quality drop, big mem/cost win. Recommend 10% canary first.
Priya (Solutions): Meridian is on Dedicated us-west-2, GPU pool is 8x A10g. Any warmup/throughput concerns to call out?
Leo (Infra): q4 should cut model mem ~30-45% depending on tensor layout. Main ops note: KV cache cold-starts can bump p95 for first hour — warmup job recommended.
Arjun (ML Eng): propose routing policy (canary):
```yaml
routing:
  - match: region == "us-west-2" && customer_id == "meridian"
    traffic_split:
      redwood-v2-base: 90
      redwood-v2-base-q4: 10
    rollout_window: 48h
    metrics: ["p95_latency_ms","error_rate","cost_per_1k_tokens"]
```
Priya (Solutions): also suggest a model-size test: redwood-v2-small at 20% vs base at 80% for throughput-sensitive endpoints. Might shave cost without quality loss for short dialogues.
Sam (AE): Meridian told our CSM they churn if p95 stays >800ms. If we can push p95 <700ms that's a strong renewal signal. :warning:
Ethan (Observability): I can add a canary dashboard + alerts. Proposed alerting: p95 >800ms -> #customer-success; error_rate >1% -> rollback; eval quality delta >2% -> manual review.
Arjun (ML Eng): evaluation quick-run (automated):
```bash
run-eval --model redwood-v2-base-q4 
         --evalset meridian_prompts.json 
         --metrics "exact_match,bleu,semantic-similarity"
```
This will surface quality regressions on their representative prompt set.
Maya (CSM): captured direct quote: "answers are fine but waiting kills flow" — I'll set expectations: 48h canary + follow-up call.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout scheduled for 2026-03-24T09:00:00Z at 10% traffic. Health checks: p95, errors, cost. Console: https://console.redwood.ai/canaries/meridian-3276543210
Nora (CS): Plan recap: 1) Start 10% q4 canary (48h) 2) Run redwood-v2-small 20% perf test in parallel 3) Watch p95, error_rate, cost_per_1k_tokens + eval metrics 4) If stable, ramp to 100% over 72h. Sam/Priya/Maya: you own customer comms. Arjun/Leo/Ethan: ops + dashboards + rollback hooks. Agree?
Priya (Solutions): Agree. I'll draft the customer note and share in the thread. :thumbsup:
Sam (AE): I'll schedule the post-canary call with Meridian for +24h check-in.
Arjun (ML Eng): Queuing model build and quant tests today.
Leo (Infra): Adding warmup job and ephemeral mem bump to avoid cold-start spikes.
Ethan (Observability): Dashboard created, will post link and alert runbook in channel once canary starts.
Nora (CS): Thanks team — I'll update the renewal tracker and ping execs if we get the expected p95 improvement. :rocket:
